page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6.6xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by x86_64 architecture. It is built on the Intel Xeon 8269CY processor clocked at 2.5 GHz, providing 24 dedicated vCPUs managed by a KVM hypervisor. The instance includes 96.0 GB of RAM, yielding a standard 1:4 compute-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU core.

The ecs.g6.6xlarge instance contains no integrated GPUs and provides zero local storage capacity. Operational configurations requiring persistent disk storage must utilize external network-attached block volumes. Baseline network bandwidth is set to 8 Gbps, and the instance comes without complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With its balanced CPU and memory allocation, this server type delivers standard hardware resource density for general enterprise computing without specialized accelerators. Suited workloads include web serving, software build pipelines, intermediate application servers, and backend database deployments backed by network storage.
